description: Offline evidence-status snapshot for prerequisites to lift the Raspberry Pi startup hardware_evidence_unknown blocker. This file is documentation/data only and does not approve firmware flashing, GPIO, motor, LED, camera, serial, network, or live-controller action.

blockers.title: Pi startup hardware evidence remains unknown
blockers.resolution_evidence_required: Record exact target board identity, MCU identity, flash/debug path, motion and endstop mappings, homing capability, rail limits, boot/reset output states, LED loaded behavior, camera trigger behavior, and reviewed approval before Pi startup can leave hardware_evidence_unknown for real hardware.
evidence_fields_required: exact target controller board revision and variant evidence
reviewed flash/debug method for the exact target
X/Y/Z step, direction, enable, and endstop mapping evidence
homing source and safe homing capability evidence for X/Y/Z
controller, motor, and LED rail voltage/current budget evidence
LED current-limit and loaded-behavior evidence for each channel
camera trigger voltage, polarity, pulse-width, and default-state evidence

blockers.title: No-motion electrical live tests are not approved
blockers.resolution_evidence_required: Record exact target identity, reviewed flash/debug method, rail limits, boot/reset states, common-reference or isolation plan, test points, and explicit review before any no-motion live electrical test.
evidence_fields_required: exact target controller board revision and MCU part
reviewed flashing/debug path and rollback path
pin voltage levels and input/output tolerance
boot/reset default state of candidate outputs
test point list and measurement equipment plan
explicit reviewer approval for no-motion live electrical tests

blockers.title: Motion and homing live tests are not approved
blockers.resolution_evidence_required: Record verified motion pins, endstop or homing inputs, driver current limits, safe low-speed limits, emergency stop or power-off path, and Z collision review before any live motion or homing test.
evidence_fields_required: X/Y/Z step, direction, and enable pin evidence
endstop or homing input pin evidence
driver type, current limit, Vref, and thermal-margin evidence
explicit reviewer approval for motion or homing live tests

blockers.title: LED live tests are not approved
blockers.resolution_evidence_required: Record LED current limits, rail limits, driver input polarity, fault/default behavior, boot/reset output states, dummy-load plan, current-sense test point, and explicit review before any LED live test.
evidence_fields_required: installed LED part or measured safe-current evidence
LED supply rail voltage and current budget
driver input polarity and fault/default behavior
temperature observation plan for first low-current test
explicit reviewer approval for LED live tests

blockers.title: Camera trigger live tests are not approved
blockers.resolution_evidence_required: Record camera trigger voltage, polarity, pulse-width requirements, protection/level shifting, boot/reset state, oscilloscope test point, and explicit review before any camera trigger live test.
evidence_fields_required: protection, level-shifter, buffer, or optocoupler design
initial dummy-signal plan with camera disconnected
explicit reviewer approval for camera trigger live tests

live_action_gates.title: Pi startup real-hardware path
prohibited_actions: lifting hardware_evidence_unknown for Pi startup real-hardware mode
opening serial or network sessions to a live controller from Pi startup
motor driver enable, motion, or homing from Pi startup
LED output drive from Pi startup
camera trigger output from Pi startup
evidence_fields_required: all pi_startup_hardware_evidence_unknown blocker fields resolved by reviewed evidence
simulator/dry-run remains the only allowed startup path until approval

live_action_gates.title: No-load output live test
prohibited_actions: commanding candidate outputs into a no-load measurement setup
observing commanded output behavior under live controller control
boot/reset waveform capture on live candidate outputs
probing any output unless all loads are disconnected or unable to respond
evidence_fields_required: exact target board and MCU identity
reviewed firmware and command path for the named output
known rail voltage levels and instrument loading limits
boot/reset state evidence for the named output class
test point and pass/fail threshold plan
proof that motors, LEDs, camera trigger input, and other loads are disconnected or unable to respond
explicit reviewer approval for the exact no-load output test

live_action_gates.title: Motion live test
prohibited_actions: Z motion without separate collision review
evidence_fields_required: verified step, direction, and enable mappings for the selected axis
safe reduced-current, reduced-speed, distance, and timeout limits
other axes disabled or otherwise prevented from motion
explicit reviewer approval naming the selected axis

live_action_gates.title: V1 manual-centered bounded X/Y and Z-focus test
prohibited_actions: travel outside +/-10 mm from manual X/Y center
Z motion outside approved focus-search range
camera trigger output outside approved camera-trigger scope
LED output outside approved lighting scope
evidence_fields_required: X/Y step, direction, and enable mappings
X/Y +/-10 mm soft envelope from manual center
initial X/Y speed 0.5-1 mm/s and acceleration 5-10 mm/s^2 or stricter limits
Z focus-search range and collision review when Z is in scope
Fluidd emergency stop and physical power removal stop path
lighting scope, including whether white constant illumination is allowed
camera-trigger scope, including whether XVS is disconnected, dummy-loaded, or connected
explicit reviewer approval naming V1 manual-centered bounded test

live_action_gates.title: Homing live test
prohibited_actions: homing input test under live controller control
Z homing without separate collision review
evidence_fields_required: selected homing source and input behavior for the named axis
verified endstop or feedback input mapping
safe speed, current, distance, timeout, and backoff limits
separate Z slide/objective collision review when Z is in scope
explicit reviewer approval naming the selected axis and homing source

live_action_gates.title: Camera trigger live test
prohibited_actions: position-indexed trigger test with camera connected
evidence_fields_required: camera trigger voltage, polarity, and pulse-width evidence
